- mathlib-raw-vo-boundary
inputs.core_mode == 'mathlib-raw-vo-boundary' && '-mathlib-raw-vo-boundary' || 
  raw-vo-boundary:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.core_mode == 'mathlib-raw-vo-boundary' && github.event.repository.private == false }}
    name: Extreme h3 token113 position2 basis and TU113 (full fields open)
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 75
    env:
      LEAN_NUM_THREADS: "2"
      OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS: "1"
      MKL_NUM_THREADS: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Download exact39 accepted CU/VO/TU archives (no extraction)
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${{ github.event.repository.private }}" = false
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvoboundary"
          for group in prior pilots; do
            mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvoboundary/$group"
            for artifact in $(python3 -B transformer/mathlib/rawvoboundary_restore.py --artifact-ids --group "$group"); do
              gh api --method GET "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$artifact" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvoboundary/$group/$artifact.json"
              curl --request GET --fail --location --retry 2 --silent --show-error \
                -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
                "$GITHUB_API_URL/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$artifact/zip" \
                -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvoboundary/$group/$artifact.zip"
            done
          done
      - name: Actual39 boundary dependency metadata controls (non-kernel)
        run: |
          TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvoboundary" python3 -B -W error transformer/mathlib/test_rawvoboundary.py --archives "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvoboundary"
      - name: Install pinned stable compiler
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/master/elan-init.sh -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvoboundary/elan-init.sh"
          sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvoboundary/elan-init.sh" -y --default-toolchain none
          echo "$HOME/.elan/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Mathlib dependencies only (serial Lake)
        timeout-minutes: 9
        run: |
          cd transformer/mathlib
          timeout -s TERM -k 20 480 lake exe cache get
      - name: Restore333, first coordinate then scalar chunk16 basis and TU113
        timeout-minutes: 57
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cd transformer/mathlib
          ./rawvoboundary.sh --archives "$RUNNER_TEMP/rawvoboundary" 2>&1 | tee rawvoboundary.ci.out
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: transformer-raw-vo-boundary-${{ github.run_id }}
          retention-days: 7
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            transformer/mathlib/rawvoboundary-out/
            transformer/mathlib/rawvoboundary*.out
            transformer/mathlib/rawvoboundary*.time
            transformer/mathlib/RawVOBoundary-checkpoint.json
            transformer/mathlib/TransformerBridge/RawCorrespondence/VOBoundaryGenerated/
            transformer/mathlib/.lake/build/lib/lean/TransformerBridge/RawCorrespondence/VOBoundaryGenerated/
          if-no-files-found: error
